name: 11411 · Cambria Hts, NY
findings: ZIP 11411 (Cambria Hts) has 82 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (21%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11411 (Cambria Hts) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
100% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 11411 (Cambria Hts) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 41% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 100% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
